additionalRules: A Riders of Theoden Army must always contain Theoden, who is always the Army's General.
Riders of Rohan do not count towards this Army's Bow Limit.

specialRules.name: "Ride for ruin and the world's ending"
specialRules.text: Friendly Rohan Cavalry models gain a bonus of +1 to their Strength on a turn in which they Charge.

specialRules.name: "Death!"
specialRules.text: Once per game, at the start of any Fight Phase, Theoden can use this special rule so long as he is alive and on the battlefield. If he does, then each friendly Rohan Hero within 12" of Theoden can declare a free Heroic Combat or a free Heroic Strike (if able) during the declare Heroic Actions Step. This is treated as an Active ability belonging to Theoden.

specialRules.name: "Forth Eorlingas!"
specialRules.text: Friendly Cavalry Warrior models within 3" of either Theoden or Eomer gain the Dominant (2) special rule.

units.name: Theoden
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Herugrim
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Additionally, if a model armed with Herugrim is involved in a Drawn Combat where the Combat is tied at this model's Fight Value, then instead of rolling off to see who wins, this model wins instead. If both sides have a similar special rule, roll off as normal.

specialRules.name: Forth, and Fear no Darkness
specialRules.text: The range of Théoden's Stand Fast is 12" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: Guthwine
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Each time a model armed with Gúthwinë rolls a natural 6 To Wound when making a Strike, they may immediately make a single additional To Wound Roll against the same target.

specialRules.name: I Shall Kill You if You Touch Him
specialRules.text: Whilst within 3" of Théoden, Éowyn may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes. Additionally, if Théoden is slain, Éowyn gains the Fearless special rule and must re-roll all failed To Wound Rolls when making Strikes against the model who slew Théoden.

specialRules.name: Merry
specialRules.text: If Éowyn is upgraded to take Merry, then Merry will be treated as a Passenger on Éowyn's horse, using the Meriadoc Brandybuck profile with a shield, and will always count as an Independent Hero. Whilst Merry is mounted, Éowyn gains Resistant to Magic, increases her Attacks characteristic to 3, and can spend Merry's Might, Will and Fate Points as if they were her own.

specialRules.name: Royal Standard of Rohan
specialRules.text: This is a Unique banner with a range of 6". Gamling does not suffer the -1 penalty to his Duel Roll for carrying a banner. Whenever a friendly Rohan Hero model within 6" of the Royal Standard of Rohan spends a Might Point, they may roll a D6. On a natural 6, the Might Point is free.

units.name: Deorwine, Chief of the King's Knights

specialRules.name: For Theoden!
specialRules.text: During the Declare Heroic Actions step of the Fight Phase, if Théoden is Engaged in Combat and is within 6" of Déorwine, then Déorwine may declare a free Heroic Combat and must use the following Move to join Théoden's Combat.

specialRules.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
specialRules.text: Elfhelm never suffers the -1 penalty for Moving and Shooting when using his throwing spear. Additionally, when throwing his spear, Elfhelm may re-roll any failed To Hit, To Wound or In The Way Rolls when making that shooting attack.

units.name: Captain of Rohan
options: Exchange Armour for Heavy Armour - 5 points

specialRules.name: Arise, Riders of Rohan!
specialRules.text: If this model is within 12" of a Rohan General and has the Cavalry keyword, it gains a bonus of +1 to its Fight Value in a turn in which it Charges.

specialRules.name: Spear Mastery
specialRules.text: This model may use its throwing spear as a normal spear during the Fight Phase, so long as it hasn't made a shooting attack with it that turn.
